title: Concept: vcpkg registry cloned over cleartext
description: vcpkg-configuration.json declares a registry repository URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The port definitions and patches are fetched unencrypted, so the build can compile a modified port.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through vcpkg-configuration.json (vcpkg).
risk: The port definitions and patches are fetched unencrypted, so the build can compile a modified port.
